reviews.text: Yoni is the man! 10/10 would recommend!

Pepper just completed a board and train stay at Balancing Paws and we couldn’t be happier with the experience.

From the beginning, they treated Pepper like family while also giving her the structure, consistency, and guidance she needed. We noticed such a difference in her confidence, responsiveness, and overall calmness after coming home. The communication throughout the stay was amazing — updates and photos via Instagram that made us feel completely comfortable and 2 referrals helped us with trusting them with our girl.

What stood out most was how balanced their approach felt. It never felt harsh or one-size-fits-all. They really took the time to understand Pepper’s personality and work with her in a way that supported both training and emotional regulation.

If you’re looking for trainers who genuinely care about dogs and their humans, I highly recommend Balancing Paws. We’re so grateful for the foundation they helped create for Pepper.

Yoni and his team saved my dog! When he lost his brother, he became so depressed and anxious, I feared I was going to lose him next. He started having both behavioral and medical issues and my vet gave me information on Balancing Paws. After working with Yoni, my dog and I started bonding on a deeper level and I am so happy to report that one year later, he is happier than I've ever seen him. He is better trained than he ever was but more importantly, he is calm and content and I can tell he feels safe. I can't say enough about Balancing Paws and what they did for us. They really care about their customers. If you're willing to put in the work, you'll see results!

We’ve been working with Yoni for training and I couldn’t be happier. Bodhi has made real progress with focus, impulse control, and confidence around other dogs. Yoni explains things clearly and makes training feel doable and realistic.

We cannot thank John enough. Coming home to a destroyed house or a high strung dog was a nightmare. John gave us practical real world training exercises that allowed us and our dog to live a more stress free life. Thank you again, highly recommend John to anyone who needs their dog in check.

(When training, there is no use of chain, choke, or shock collars. All training is food and behavior motivated.)
We have had other trainers and we got more out of one session here than complete packages other places

We recently took our new 1 year old rescue pup Kenny to Balancing Paws for a 2 week boot camp training. He had been a stray and he lacked confidence when outside with pretty much everything. When we picked him up and took him for a walk next to a busy street we were amazed with his new found confidence! He had no recall either before he went to BP and now when we call him he comes running. We couldn't be happier. We are continuing with the group classes that come with the training to continue to keep learning. We actually found Yoni at BP over 11 years ago and our 2 pups then were trained there. We were always asked how we got our dogs to be so well behaved. As you can see from the photo the 12 year old still does place really well and now so does Kenny! Yoni, John and Jenna are outstanding.

Yoni and his Balancing Paws crew have been exceptional for my fur babies and family over the years. He helped my two pitties who were a year at the time. Their names were Blue and Zoey back in 2016. They were aggressive with eachother and I was pregnant with a little baby. He came and trained my two pitties. When my baby  was due I decided to do boarding/training while I had to focus on becoming a mom and bringing a baby home. He worked exceptionally well with Blue and Zoey. He went above and beyond for them and it showed especially later in their lives. 🤗 I was able to share the best moments watching Blue and Zoey not only be amazing to my heart but they grew up so loving and special with my daughter too. Unfortunately they passed within a year apart due to health issues. Blue passed 2 years ago and Zoey girl passed in late June this year. I miss them dearly. With that heavy heart I decided to go to a rescue to help save at least one pup.
I now have a rescue puppy that we recently boarded and put into training. Her name is Chloe. She turns 5 months October 7th. I can already see how the training with Yoni and Balancing Paws has made such an impact with this sweet new puppy and addition to our family. My dogs are my children and I don’t just trust anyone with my babies. Thank you Yoni and the whole Balancing Paws team for being apart of my babies learning and teaching them. I seriously love you guys. 🐶❤️

When I went with a friend to check out his services for their k9 who had over reactive aggression issues,  3 things became crystal clear.  1. I would never take my dog there, 2.the k9 that was being evaluated was fully ready to escape over his fence wall, on to a busy street and would have had I not been watching, 3.the compressed air can he uses for correction completely triggered my perfect dog at home to  accidentally attack my hand (I ordered some to have for babysitting). That was a nightmare experience for me and my dog and caused the full stop with this place.
I don't think the very expensive bootcamp and training methods he is sold on using are good.  Lastly, the fact that the k9 is crate confined for 95% of the day was a full stop for me.
I understand everyone is different and every k9 is different.  I think everyone should really put themselves their dogs place before doing this to them.  The training area is small and doesn't have a pool so the pictures are a misrepresentation.

Yoni and his team at Balancing Paws are absolutely incredible. Grizzly went from puppy-brain to being the most well behaved obedient boy in a matter of weeks, and he's happier than ever because he has more freedoms now. BP training also comes with a very well put together online curriculum so we have everything accessible for us to continue his trainings at home. Btw they were also very accommodating anytime I needed to adjust my schedule. Just good people overall, I highly recommend

Balancing Paws has been an incredible partner on our journey with Finn, our scared, timid, and unconfident rescue pup from an Indian reservation in Arizona. From the very beginning, Yoni, along with his amazing team—John and Jenna—have shown unwavering dedication, patience, and heart in helping Finn grow.

We’ve worked with them through both the 1:1 training package and the board and train program, and the progress we’ve seen has been nothing short of remarkable. What truly sets Balancing Paws apart is their commitment—they’ve never given up on Finn, even during his most challenging moments. They’re always just a message or call away, offering thoughtful advice and support whenever we need it.

As new parents with our first baby, we were nervous about how Finn would adapt. Yoni didn’t just train Finn—he trained us too. His guidance has helped us create a safe, loving environment for everyone in our growing family. When we drop Finn off for board and train, we have complete peace of mind knowing he’s in the best hands possible.

Thank you, Balancing Paws, for your passion, your persistence, and for helping keep our family whole.

If you’re on the fence about choosing Balancing Paws, this review is for you.

This is the best, easiest, fastest, and probably most affordable way to train your dog.

We had worked with a different trainer before - but our dog kept pulling, being reactive to other dogs.

When we asked this other trainer for help, we got more of the same advice that wasn’t working.

I didn’t see a way out and thought that’s just how things would be.

Then I found Balancing Paws through a friends recommendation.

I was struck by the effectiveness of their methods. They understand dogs.

Our dog walked perfectly on the leash within 5 minutes of the first session.

She stopped jumping on us after the first session too.

She’s no longer reactive to other dogs.

I can actually get close to other people and have a conversation without our dog pulling or barking.

It felt like going from constant tension with our dog to a huge relief, partnership and control.

Literally life changing.

Do yourself a favor and hire Balancing Paws.
